qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: World's largest chemicals and ingredients distributor, but operating EBIT margins of 4.5-5.5% and multi-cycle GAAP ROIC of ~9% fail the 12% hurdle. Bulk industrial chemicals (Brenntag Essentials, ~65% of gross profit) face low customer switching costs and commodity pricing pressure, while chemical principals can bypass or re-tender distributor mandates.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). World's largest chemical distributor operates primarily in commoditized bulk chemicals with low customer switching barriers and high principal substitution risk. Historical GAAP ROIC (~9%) and operating margins (4.5-5.5%) fail the Munger quality hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC averages 8.5-9.5%, failing the >=12% hurdle. Operating EBIT margins remain thin at ~4.5-5.5%. Bulk industrial chemical volumes are cyclical and vulnerable to European industrial weakness and chemical price deflation. Net debt stands at ~€2.5-3.0B (leverage ~2.0-2.3x EBITDA).
